independent_gallery.author: 王愈晔
independent_gallery.caption_associated_by: The text about 山阴路209弄 and the photograph are properties of section 6 in the published gallery data. The distinct paired segment by numbers 1 and 2 has darker, multi-barred timber. Its arch family confirms the shared architecture; its sash differs from the light-coloured three-window group in the Fayhoo photograph.

picture_coordinates: Coordinates in the dated 2144 by 1424 published image. Each rectangle is represented by its two visible structural jamb lines, local spring and head levels. Some sill edges behind wash or plant cover are estimated by the surviving rail/next clear stretch.

left_to_right.visibility: foliage at the head; exterior lower right masked by hanging articles
most clearly exposed arch and central spoke junction; lower right contains partial temporary items
branches obscure local head and part of lower left; right jamb and sill return visible

group: All three white fanlights have a small central arc, a central vertical and two oblique radial bars. A broad pale transom crosses at spring level. The lower central frame shows three intermediate uprights and four unequal lights. Temporary domestic fittings are excluded.
rights: Fayhoo, 2015-04-12, CC BY-SA 3.0. A cropped comparison must carry this attribution, the source and the license, and identify cropping. Wang’s separate gallery is cited for verification only.

tone_samples.method: Median RGB in narrow luminance percentiles of a small clear area on the centre arch, without removing natural shadow. These served as a tonal guide for original materials.
